caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with a fitted bodice, wide bell sleeves, and a very full skirt that extends outward in a dome shape. The dress is rendered in color and features a horizontal striped pattern in alternating shades of reddish-brown and off-white or cream. There are three prominent horizontal bands on the skirt, emphasized with yellow trim or ruffles, which also appear at the edges of the sleeves and hem. The bodice is form-fitting with a high, round neckline, and vertical stripes continue from the bodice onto the skirt. An uncolored pencil sketch of the same dress design appears in the upper right corner of the drawing, showing the garment from the back. The background of the drawing is plain, untextured, and beige in color.
title: Dress
